title: D2.3 log event
description: One record in the D2.3 logging server.

id.description: Set by the logging server: urn:uuid:...

seq.description: Set by the logging server: position in the log, from 1.

recordedAt.description: Set by the logging server: UTC time it stored the event.

time.description: UTC time the event happened, as the sender says. Optional.

source.description: Component that wrote the event. 'run-script' marks events the demo script writes on behalf of UMA or the pod, until they post their own.

correlation.description: One identifier per access attempt, carried from request to decision to access. Use the first UMA ticket.

claimTypes.description: Kinds of claims shown. Never their content.

rules.description: Rules that decided, from the compliance report.

prevHash.description: Set by the logging server: hash of the previous record.

hash.description: Set by the logging server: sha256 over prevHash and this record.
